PresenterIntent: Project a composed item and its parts into role-aware sections with local action presentations near each actionable part.
RecognizerIntent: Build typed action requests for part removal, addition, substitution, configuration, and order/cart actions.
LoweringRationale: Street Deli composition editing is the richest current fixture for PBUI. A single target component is not enough to explain it; the PBUI obligation should preserve part roles, substitutions, configuration, local edit actions, and cart actions as presentation-system concepts that React can compile into selectors, hooks, components, and event adapters.
